plugin.scope_note: Published plugin is immutable. Native Site submit adapters extend its transport and resolver; platform-specific changes are canonical under site/native, not a claim of byte parity with the immutable plugin runtime.

github.checkpoint_commit_policy: The subsequent metadata commit is reported separately; its own ID cannot be embedded in itself.

repair: Preserve all selected action IDs, even when typed details are present.
Resolve source-defined camp approach as well as charter departure; recognize exact typed prepared choice text.
Bind selection arrays into idempotency fingerprints.
Keep unsupported multi-actions atomic and fail closed; preserve queued drafts and clarify that the scene did not advance.

rollback.procedure: Restore a reviewed prior saved version on the SAME Site. Do not reset D1/R2, campaign saves or receipts. Preserve the published stable plugin.

remaining_evidence_boundaries: Owner-authenticated production scene/party/art remains unverified: Google phone approval was not completed in the QA browser. Live homepage/settings and the sign-in-required boundary were observed after publication.

The native source contains 16 story nodes and 52 active choices. Only fully specified prepared transitions and supported dashboard reviews resolve automatically. Freeform requests without an exact choice match and combinations requiring unavailable rules remain queued with no gameplay changes. No complete combat or story adjudicator was invented.

390px iframe QA is not a physical iPhone test. Audio playing status was observed, but no listening-quality claim is made. Reduced-motion CSS is retained; OS emulation was not performed. Full plugin binary archive parity remains unverified.
